questions.stem:
13. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2-48x-36y-621=0.
\]
Let \(G\) be the centre of \(C\). Denote the origin by \(O\).
(a) Find \(OG\).
(b) Does \(O\) lie inside \(C\)? Explain your answer.
(c) Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(OP=GP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Suppose that \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(A\) and \(B\). Evan claims that \(\angle AGB<135^\circ\). Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 圓的方程為 \(x^2+y^2-48x-36y-621=0\)，圓心為 \(G\)。
(a) 求 \(OG\)，並判斷原點 \(O\) 是否在圓內。
(b) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(OP=GP\)。軌跡 \(\Gamma\) 與該圓相交於 \(A,B\)。判斷 \(\angle AGB<135^\circ\) 是否正確，並解釋。
questions.solution:
English Solution
13.
(a) Completing the square, the centre of \(C\) is
\[
G=(24,18).
\]
Thus
\[
OG=\sqrt{24^2+18^2}=30.
\]
(b) The radius of \(C\) is
\[
\sqrt{24^2+18^2-(-621)}=39.
\]
Since
\[
39>30,
\]
\(O\) lies inside \(C\).
(c) The locus \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(OG\). Since \(A\) and \(B\) lie on \(C\),
\[
AG=BG=39.
\]
Also \(AO=BO=39\) because \(A\) and \(B\) lie on the locus \(OP=GP\). Therefore,
\[
\angle AOG=\angle BOG=\angle AGO=\angle BGO=\frac{1}{2}\angle AGB.
\]
Using \(\triangle AOG\),
\[
\cos\frac{\angle AGB}{2}=\frac{\frac{1}{2}OG}{AG}
=\frac{15}{39}.
\]
Hence
\[
\frac{\angle AGB}{2}\approx 67.38013505^\circ,
\]
so
\[
\angle AGB\approx 134.7602701^\circ.
\]
Since
\[
134.7602701^\circ<135^\circ,
\]
the claim is agreed.
questions.solutionZh:
中文詳解
答案：配方得圓心 \(G=(24,18)\)，半徑 \(39\)。因此 \(OG=\sqrt{24^2+18^2}=30<39\)，原點在圓內。
由 \(OP=GP\)，\(\Gamma\) 是 \(OG\) 的垂直平分線。計算其與圓的交點所對的圓心角，得 \(\angle AGB\approx134.7603^\circ<135^\circ\)，所以聲稱正確。

questions.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A=(-10,0)\)、\(B=(30,0)\)，圓心 \(G\) 的 \(y\) 坐標為 \(-15\)。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。
(b) 直線 \(L\) 通過 \(B,G\)；直線 \(\ell\) 平行於 \(L\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩直線的垂直距離相等，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)，且 \(\Gamma\) 經過 \(A\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(L\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(iii) \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 的另一交點為 \(H\)。有人聲稱 \(\angle GAH<70^\circ\)。你是否同意？解釋。（9 分）
questions.solution:
English Solution
(a) G=(10,-15), radius 25; C:(x-10)²+(y+15)²=625.
(b)(i) The locus is parallel to L.
(ii) L has slope 3/4, so the locus through A is 3x-4y+30=0.
(iii) AG has direction -atan(3/4); AH has direction atan(3/4). Thus the angle is 2atan(3/4)=73.74 degrees. Disagree.
questions.solutionZh:
中文詳解
(a) 圓心在 \(AB\) 的垂直平分線 \(x=10\) 上，故 \(G=(10,-15)\)。半徑平方為 \(20^2+15^2=625\)：
\[C:(x-10)^2+(y+15)^2=625.\]
(b)(i) \(\Gamma\) 是兩平行線的中線，故 \(\Gamma\parallel L\)。
(ii) \(L\) 斜率為 \(15/20=3/4\)，過 \(A\) 的平行線為 \(3x-4y+30=0\)。
(iii) 射線 \(AG\) 與正 \(x\) 軸夾角為 \(-\arctan(3/4)\)，射線 \(AH\) 的方向角為 \(\arctan(3/4)\)。故 \(\angle GAH=2\arctan(3/4)\approx73.74^\circ>70^\circ\)，不同意。

10. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-4,3)\) and \((6,5)\) respectively. Let \(G\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(A G=B G\). Denote the locus of \(G\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(A B\).
(b) If \(A B\) is a chord of the circle \(x^{2}+y^{2}-2 a x+4 a y-85=0\), where \(a\) is a constant, find the value of \(a\).
questions.stemZh:
10. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((-4,3)\) 和 \((6,5)\)。動點 \(G\) 在直角坐標平面上移動，並滿足 \(AG=BG\)。以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(G\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(ii) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(AB\) 的幾何關係。
(b) 若 \(AB\) 為圓 \(x^2+y^2-2ax+4ay-85=0\) 的弦，其中 \(a\) 為常數，求 \(a\) 的值。
questions.hint: AG=BG means G is equidistant from A and B — write the distance formula, square both sides, and simplify. For (b), remember the perpendicular bisector of a chord always passes through the circle centre.
questions.hintZh: AG=BG 即 G 到 A、B 等距——寫距離公式，兩邊平方化簡。(b) 記住弦的垂直平分線必過圓心。
questions.solution:
10. (a)(i) Let \((x, y)\) be the coordinates of \(G\).

\[
\begin{aligned}
& \because \quad A G=B G \\
& \quad \begin{aligned}
\sqrt{[x-(-4)]^{2}+(y-3)^{2}} & =\sqrt{(x-6)^{2}+(y-5)^{2}} \\
\therefore \quad x^{2}+8 x+16+y^{2}-6 y+9 & =x^{2}-12 x+36+y^{2}-10 y+25 \\
20 x+4 y-36 & =0 \\
5 x+y-9 & =0
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}
\]

Thus, the equation of \(\Gamma\) is \(5 x+y-9=0\).
(ii) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of the line segment \(A B\).
(b) Note that perpendicular bisector \(\Gamma\) of chord \(A B\) passes through the centre of the circle.

The coordinates of the centre of the circle are \((a,-2 a)\).

By (a), we have \(5 a-2 a-9=0\).

So, we have \(a=3\).

& \therefore \quad x^{2}+8x+16+y^{2}-6y+9=x^{2}-12x+36+y^{2}-10y+25 \\

圓心坐標為 (a,−2a)。

由 (a) 得 \(5a−2a−9=0\)。

所以 \(a=3\)。

questions.stem:
12. \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the distance between \(P\) and the line \(L: y=-3\) is always equal to the distance from \(P\) to a fixed point \(C(2,-1)\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the locus of p .
(b) Find the equation of a circle with centre \(C\) which touches \(\Gamma\).
questions.stemZh:
12. 動點 \(P\) 與直線 \(L:y=-3\) 的距離，恆等於 \(P\) 與固定點 \(C=(2,-1)\) 的距離，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(a) (i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程；(ii) 描述 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(b) 求一個以 \(C\) 為圓心且與 \(\Gamma\) 相切的圓的方程。
questions.hint: Distance from P to line y=-3 is |y+3|. Set it equal to sqrt((x-2)²+(y+1)²) and square. The result is a parabola — find its vertex for (b).
questions.hintZh: P 到 y=-3 的距離是 |y+3|，等於 sqrt((x-2)²+(y+1)²)，平方後是拋物線。(b) 找頂點。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) Let \(P=(x,y)\). Equating the two nonnegative distances and squaring gives
\[(y+3)^2=(x-2)^2+(y+1)^2.\]
Thus \((x-2)^2=4(y+2)\), or \(y=\tfrac14x^2-x-1\).
(ii) The locus is a parabola, with focus \(C=(2,-1)\), directrix \(y=-3\) and vertex \((2,-2)\).
(b) Put \(u=(x-2)^2\ge0\). On the parabola, \(y+1=u/4-1\), so the squared distance from C is
\[CP^2=u+(u/4-1)^2=1+u/2+u^2/16\ge1.\]
Equality holds only at the vertex. Therefore the circle centred at C which touches the parabola has radius 1:
\[(x-2)^2+(y+1)^2=1.\]

questions.stem:
12. The coordinates of the points A and B are (–14 , 0) and (34 , 0) respectively. The circle C passes through A 
and B . The radius of C is 30 . Denote the centre of C by G and G lies in Quadrant I . 
 (a) Find the equation of C . (3 marks) 
 (b) P is a moving point in the rectangular plane such that AP = GP . Denote the locus of P by Γ . 
 (i) Describe the geometric relationship between Γ and AG . 
(ii) If Γ cuts C at Q and R , Mr. Cheng claims that the area of the quadrilateral QARG is less than 
780 . Do you agree? Explain your answer. 
(4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 點 \(A\) 和 \(B\) 的坐標分別為 \((-14,0)\) 和 \((34,0)\)。圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A\)、\(B\)，半徑為 \(30\)；圓心 \(G\) 位於第一象限。
(a) 求圓 \(C\) 的方程。
(b) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=GP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AG\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(Q,R\)，有人聲稱四邊形 \(QARG\) 的面積小於 \(780\)。你是否同意？解釋答案。
questions.hint: GA=GB means G is on the perpendicular bisector of AB. Since A,B are on x-axis, that bisector is x=10. Then use radius 30 to find k.
questions.hintZh: GA=GB 即 G 在 AB 垂直平分線上。A、B 在 x 軸，平分線是 x=10，再用半徑 30 求 k。
questions.solution:
(a) Since \(GA=GB\), \(G\) lies on the perpendicular bisector \(x=10\). Put \(G=(10,k)\). From \(GA=30\),

\[
24^2+k^2=30^2,\qquad k=\pm18.
\]

As \(G\) lies in quadrant I, \(G=(10,18)\). Hence

\[
C:(x-10)^2+(y-18)^2=900.
\]

(b)(i) Since \(AP=GP\), \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(AG\).
(ii) At the intersections, \(QA=QG=RA=RG=30\), so \(QARG\) is a rhombus. Let \(M=\Gamma\cap AG\). Then \(AG=30\) and \(MG=15\). In right triangle \(GMQ\),

\[
MQ=\sqrt{30^2-15^2}=15\sqrt3,\qquad QR=30\sqrt3.
\]

The diagonals are perpendicular, so

\[
[QARG]=\frac12(AG)(QR)=450\sqrt3\approx779.42<780.
\]

Therefore the claim is correct.
questions.solutionZh:
答案：
(a) 因為 \(GA=GB\)，圓心位於 \(AB\) 的垂直平分線 \(x=10\)。設 \(G=(10,k)\)。由 \(GA=30\)，得 \((10+14)^2+k^2=30^2\)，所以 \(k=\pm18\)。\(G\) 位於第一象限，故 \(G=(10,18)\)，因此
\[C:(x-10)^2+(y-18)^2=900.\]
(b)(i) 由 \(AP=GP\)，\(\Gamma\) 是線段 \(AG\) 的垂直平分線。
(b)(ii) 因為 \(QA=QG=RA=RG=30\)，\(QARG\) 為菱形。設 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AG\) 相交於 \(M\)，則 \(AG=30\)，\(MG=15\)。由直角三角形 \(GMQ\)，得 \(MQ=\sqrt{30^2-15^2}=15\sqrt3\)，所以 \(QR=30\sqrt3\)。兩條對角線互相垂直，因此
\[[QARG]=\frac12(AG)(QR)=450\sqrt3\approx779.42<780.\]
所以聲稱正確。

questions.stem:
13. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2+kx-32y+256=0,
\]where \(k\) is a constant. Let \(G\) be the centre of \(C\). \(A\) is a point lying on the \(y\)-axis and the equation of the straight line passing through \(A\) and \(G\) is
\[
3x+4y-28=0.
\](a) Find \(k\). (2 marks)
(b) Does \(A\) lie outside \(C\)? Explain your answer. (2 marks)
(c) Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=GP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). Suppose \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(M\) and \(N\). Is the area of \(\triangle GMN\) less than \(68\) square units? Explain your answer. (3 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 圓 \(C\) 的方程為 \(x^2+y^2+kx-32y+256=0\)，其中 \(k\) 為常數。以 \(G\) 表示圓心。點 \(A\) 位於 \(y\) 軸上，直線 \(AG\) 的方程為 \(3x+4y-28=0\)。
(a) 求 \(k\)。（2 分）
(b) \(A\) 是否位於圓 \(C\) 外？解釋答案。（2 分）
(c) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=GP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示 \(P\) 的軌跡。若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(M,N\)，\(\triangle GMN\) 的面積是否小於 \(68\) 平方單位？解釋答案。（3 分）
questions.hint: Centre is (-k/2, 16). Substitute into the line 3x+4y-28=0. For (b), find A at x=0 and compare AG with radius.
questions.hintZh: 圓心 (-k/2, 16) 代入 3x+4y-28=0。(b) 令 x=0 找 A，比較 AG 同半徑。
questions.solution:
(a) The centre is \(G=(-\frac{k}{2},16)\). Substitution into \(AG\) gives

\[
3(-\tfrac{k}{2})+4(16)-28=0,
\]

so \(k=24\). Thus \(G=(-12,16)\) and the radius is \(12\).

(b) Setting \(x=0\) gives \(A=(0,7)\). Since \(AG=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15>12\), \(A\) is outside \(C\).

(c) \(\Gamma\) is the perpendicular bisector of \(AG\). Let \(Q=AG\cap\Gamma\), so \(GQ=\frac{15}{2}\). The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord:

\[
MQ=\sqrt{12^2-(\tfrac{15}{2})^2}=\tfrac{\sqrt{351}}2,\qquad MN=\sqrt{351}.
\]

The triangle height is \(GQ\), not \(AG\). Hence

\[
[GMN]=\tfrac12\sqrt{351}\cdot\tfrac{15}{2}=\tfrac{45\sqrt{39}}4\approx70.26>68.
\]

The area is not less than \(68\) square units.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 圓心為 \(G=(-\frac{k}{2},16)\)。代入 \(AG\) 的方程：
\[3(-\tfrac{k}{2})+4(16)-28=0,\]
得 \(k=24\)，故 \(G=(-12,16)\)、半徑為 \(12\)。
(b) 令 \(x=0\)，得 \(A=(0,7)\)。\(AG=\sqrt{12^2+9^2}=15>12\)，所以 \(A\) 位於圓外。
(c) \(\Gamma\) 是 \(AG\) 的垂直平分線。設 \(Q=AG\cap\Gamma\)，則 \(GQ=\frac{15}{2}\)。由圓心到弦的垂線平分弦：
\[MQ=\sqrt{12^2-(\tfrac{15}{2})^2}=\tfrac{\sqrt{351}}2,\]
故 \(MN=\sqrt{351}\)。三角形的高度是 \(GQ\)，不是整段 \(AG\)：
\[[GMN]=\tfrac12\sqrt{351}\cdot\tfrac{15}{2}=\tfrac{45\sqrt{39}}4\approx70.26.\]
因此面積不小於 \(68\) 平方單位。

14. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2+mx+ny-560=0,
\]where \(m\) and \(n\) are constants. Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(G\). The straight line \(L\) cuts \(C\) at the points \(R\) and \(S\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(RP=SP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). It is given that the coordinates of \(R\) are \((12,44)\) and the equation of \(\Gamma\) is
\[
x-3y+30=0.
\](a) Find \(m\) and \(n\).
(b) Find the equation of \(L\).
(c) \(T\) is a point lying on \(C\) such that \(RT=RS\). Someone claims that the area of \(\triangle RST\) exceeds \(980\) square units. Do you agree? Explain your answer.
(8 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 圓 \(C\) 的方程為 \(x^2+y^2+mx+ny-560=0\)，其中 \(m,n\) 為常數，以 \(G\) 表示圓心。直線 \(L\) 與 \(C\) 交於 \(R,S\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(RP=SP\)，以 \(\Gamma\) 表示其軌跡。已知 \(R=(12,44)\)，\(\Gamma\) 的方程為 \(x-3y+30=0\)。
(a) 求 \(m,n\)。
(b) 求 \(L\) 的方程。
(c) 點 \(T\) 位於 \(C\) 上，並滿足 \(RT=RS\)。有人聲稱 \(\triangle RST\) 的面積大於 \(980\) 平方單位。你是否同意？解釋答案。（8 分）
questions.hint: R is on the circle → substitute. RP=SP locus is perpendicular bisector of RS, which passes through centre G. Solve two equations for m,n.
questions.hintZh: R 在圓上代入。RP=SP 的軌跡是 RS 垂直平分線，過圓心 G。兩方程解 m,n。
questions.solution:
(a) Substituting \(R=(12,44)\) gives \(3m+11n=-380\). The perpendicular bisector \(\Gamma\) passes through \(G=(-\frac m2,-\frac n2)\), giving \(m-3n=60\). Thus \(m=-24\), \(n=-28\) and \(G=(12,14)\).

(b) Since \(L\perp\Gamma\), its slope is \(-3\). Through \(R\), \(y-44=-3(x-12)\), or \(3x+y-80=0\).

(c) The intersection of \(L\) and \(\Gamma\) is the chord midpoint \(H=(21,17)\), so \(S=2H-R=(30,-10)\). Reflection in \(RG:x=12\) gives the other point \(T=(-6,-10)\) with \(RT=RS\). Hence \(ST=36\) and the height from \(R\) is \(54\):

\[
[RST]=\tfrac12(36)(54)=972<980.
\]

The claim is false. If \(T=S\), the area is \(0\) and the claim remains false.

13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((5,10)\) and \((-1,2)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(BP=AB\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) It is given that the coordinates of the point \(H\) are \((-11,2)\).
(i) Does \(\Gamma\) pass through \(H\)? Explain your answer.
(ii) Find the distance between \(A\) and \(H\).
(iii) \(K\) is a point lying on \(\Gamma\). Someone claims that the area of \(\triangle AHK\) cannot exceed \(150\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(7 marks)
questions.hint: BP=AB is a circle centred at B. Max triangle area when K is farthest from line AH — add centre-to-line distance to radius.
questions.hintZh: BP=AB 是以 B 為心的圓。面積最大當 K 離 AH 最遠——中心到線距離加半徑。
questions.solution:
13.

(a) Since \(BP=AB\), the locus \(\Gamma\) is the circle with centre \(B(-1,2)\) and radius \(AB\).

Now

\[
AB^2=(5-(-1))^2+(10-2)^2=6^2+8^2=100.
\]

Therefore,

\[
(x+1)^2+(y-2)^2=100.
\]

(b)(i) For \(H(-11,2)\),

\[
(-11+1)^2+(2-2)^2=100.
\]

Therefore, \(\Gamma\) passes through \(H\).

(b)(ii)

\[
AH=\sqrt{(-11-5)^2+(2-10)^2}
=\sqrt{320}
=8\sqrt5.
\]

(b)(iii) The maximum area of \(\triangle AHK\) occurs when the perpendicular distance from \(K\) to \(AH\) is greatest.

The line \(AH\) has equation

\[
x-2y+15=0.
\]

The perpendicular distance from the centre \(B(-1,2)\) to \(AH\) is

\[
\frac{|(-1)-2(2)+15|}{\sqrt{1^2+(-2)^2}}
=\frac{10}{\sqrt5}
=2\sqrt5.
\]

Since the radius of \(\Gamma\) is \(10\), the greatest perpendicular distance from \(K\) to \(AH\) is

\[
10+2\sqrt5.
\]

Hence the maximum area is

\[
\frac12(8\sqrt5)(10+2\sqrt5)
=40\sqrt5+40
\approx 129.4<150.
\]

Therefore, the claim is correct.

questions.stem:
13. The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
x^2+y^2-18x+ky=0,
\]where \(k\) is a positive constant. Suppose \(C\) cuts the positive \(x\)-axis and the negative \(y\)-axis at points \(A\) and \(B\) respectively. Denote the origin by \(O\). Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=AO\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\). (3 marks)
(b) It is given that \(C\) and \(\Gamma\) intersect at \(O\) and the point \(G\), where
\[
5AG=3AB.
\](i) Find the value of \(k\).
(ii) Find the area of the quadrilateral \(OAGB\). (4 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. 圓 \(C:x^2+y^2-18x+ky=0\)，\(k>0\)，分別與正 \(x\) 軸、負 \(y\) 軸交於 \(A,B\)。原點為 \(O\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=AO\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 方程。（3 分）
(b) \(C\) 與 \(\Gamma\) 交於 \(O,G\)，且 \(5AG=3AB\)。
(i) 求 \(k\)；(ii) 求四邊形 \(OAGB\) 面積。（4 分）
questions.hint: Find A from x-intercept. AG=18, AB=30, use Pythagoras for k. Split area into two triangles.
questions.hintZh: 找 x 截距 A。AG=18, AB=30，畢氏定理求 k。面積分兩三角形。
questions.solution:
(a) Setting y=0 gives \(A=(18,0)\). Since \(AP=AO=18\),
\[\Gamma:(x-18)^2+y^2=324.\]
(b)(i) Since G lies on this circle, \(AG=18\). Then \(5AG=3AB\) gives \(AB=30\). With \(B=(0,-k)\), \(18^2+k^2=30^2\), and positivity gives \(k=24\).
(ii) Subtracting the two circle equations gives \(18x+24y=0\). The second intersection is \(G=(576/25,-432/25)\). As AB is a diameter of C, triangle AGB is right-angled; its legs are AG=18 and BG=24, so its area is 216. Triangle OAB also has area 216. They are on opposite sides of AB, so \([OAGB]=216+216=432\).

13. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((5,10)\) and \((-1,2)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(BP=AB\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) (i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(B\). (3 marks)
(b) It is given that the coordinates of the point \(H\) are \((-9,8)\).
(i) Does \(\Gamma\) pass through \(H\)? Explain your answer.
(ii) \(K\) is a point lying on \(\Gamma\) such that \(ABHK\) is a quadrilateral. Someone claims that the area of \(ABHK\) cannot exceed \(70\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer. (5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
13. \(A=(5,10)\)、\(B=(-1,2)\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(BP=AB\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a)(i) 求軌跡方程；(ii) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(B\) 的關係。（3 分）
(b) \(H=(-9,8)\)。
(i) 軌跡是否經過 \(H\)？解釋。
(ii) \(K\) 在軌跡上，且 \(ABHK\) 為四邊形。有人聲稱其面積不會超過 \(70\)。聲稱是否正確？解釋。（5 分）
questions.hint: Circle centred at B radius 10. AH length known. Max height = centre-to-AH distance + radius. Compare with claimed value.
questions.hintZh: 以 B 為心半徑 10。AH 長已知。最大高 = 中心到 AH 距離加半徑。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) \(AB^2=6^2+8^2=100\), so \(\Gamma:(x+1)^2+(y-2)^2=100\).
(ii) The locus is the circle centred at B with radius 10.
(b)(i) \(BH^2=64+36=100\), so H lies on the circle.
(ii) The line AH is \(x-7y+65=0\). Its length is \(AH=10\sqrt2\), and the distance from B to AH is \(5\sqrt2\). For the convex quadrilateral ABHK, K lies on the opposite side of AH from B. The greatest height of K on that side is \(10-5\sqrt2\), not \(10+5\sqrt2\). Hence
\[\begin{aligned}{[AHK]}_{\max}&=\tfrac12(10\sqrt2)\\&\quad\cdot(10-5\sqrt2)\\&=50\sqrt2-50.\end{aligned}\]
\([ABH]=50\). Adding the two triangle areas gives
\[[ABHK]_{\max}=50\sqrt2.\]
\(50\sqrt2\approx70.71>70\).
Disagree. This maximum is attained by \(K=(-1-\sqrt2,2+7\sqrt2)\), which is on the circle and on the required side. The earlier value \(100+50\sqrt2\) added an incompatible height and overcounted the quadrilateral.
questions.solutionZh:
(a)(i) \(AB^2=6^2+8^2=100\)，故 \(\Gamma:(x+1)^2+(y-2)^2=100\)。
(ii) 軌跡是以 B 為圓心、半徑 10 的圓。
(b)(i) \(BH^2=64+36=100\)，所以 H 在圓上。
(ii) \(AH:x-7y+65=0\)，\(AH=10\sqrt2\)，B 到 AH 的距離為 \(5\sqrt2\)。凸四邊形 ABHK 要求 K 與 B 位於 AH 的兩側，因此 K 在該側的最大高度是 \(10-5\sqrt2\)，不是 \(10+5\sqrt2\)。所以
\[\begin{aligned}{[AHK]}_{\max}&=\tfrac12(10\sqrt2)\\&\quad\cdot(10-5\sqrt2)\\&=50\sqrt2-50.\end{aligned}\]
\([ABH]=50\)，把兩三角形面積相加，得
\[[ABHK]_{\max}=50\sqrt2.\]
\(50\sqrt2\approx70.71>70\).
不同意。取 \(K=(-1-\sqrt2,2+7\sqrt2)\) 即可達到此最大值；此點在圓上且位於所需的一側。舊版的 \(100+50\sqrt2\) 錯用另一側高度，重複計算四邊形面積。

\(A=(2,5)\). \(P\) satisfies \(PA=2\); call its locus \(C\).
(a)(i) Describe \(C\) relative to \(A\). (ii) Find its equation.
(b) \(Q:y=-x^2+4x-1\). (i) Find its vertex by completing the square. (ii) Describe the geometric relation between \(C,Q\).
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(2,5)\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(PA=2\)，軌跡為 \(C\)。
(a)(i) 描述 \(C\) 與 \(A\) 的關係。(ii) 求其方程。
(b) \(Q:y=-x^2+4x-1\)。(i) 配方求頂點。(ii) 描述 \(C,Q\) 的幾何關係。
questions.hint: Circle centred at A radius 2. Parabola y=3-(x-2)² has vertex (2,3). Substitute circle into parabola.
questions.hintZh: 以 A 為心半徑 2。拋物線頂點 (2,3)。代入圓方程。
questions.solution:
(a) A circle centred at \(A\) with radius \(2\); \((x-2)^2+(y-5)^2=4\).
(b)(i) \(y=3-(x-2)^2\), so the vertex is \((2,3)\).
(ii) They touch at \((2,3)\). Write \(z=(x-2)^2\ge0\). Substitution gives \(z+(z+2)^2=4\), hence \(z(z+5)=0\). Only \(z=0\) is possible; both tangents there are horizontal.

questions.stem:
\(O\) is the origin and \(A=(3,0)\). \(P\) is a moving point such that \(PO:PA=1:2\).
(a) Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma\) of \(P\). Describe \(\Gamma\) geometrically.
(b) The straight line \(L: y=x+k\) is tangent to \(\Gamma\). Find the values of \(k\).
(c) A tangent is drawn from \(A\) to \(\Gamma\). Find the length of this tangent.
questions.stemZh:
\(O\) 為原點，\(A=(3,0)\)。\(P\) 滿足 \(PO:PA=1:2\)。
(a) 求軌跡 \(\Gamma\) 並作幾何描述。
(b) \(y=x+k\) 與 \(\Gamma\) 相切。求 \(k\)。
(c) 從 \(A\) 向 \(\Gamma\) 作切線。求切線長。
questions.hint: Square the ratio, rearrange into circle. Distance from line to centre = radius for tangent.
questions.hintZh: 平方比例，化成圓。中心到線距離 = 半徑即相切。
questions.solution:
(a) \(4(x^2+y^2)=(x-3)^2+y^2\), giving \((x+1)^2+y^2=4\), centre \((-1,0)\) and radius \(2\).
(b) \(|k-1|/\sqrt2=2\), hence \(k=1\pm2\sqrt2\).
(c) The centre-to-\(A\) distance is \(4\), so the tangent length is \(\sqrt{4^2-2^2}=2\sqrt3\).

The coordinates of \(A\) and \(B\) are \((-2,0)\) and \((1,0)\) respectively. \(P\) is a moving point such that \(PA=2PB\).
(a) Find the equation of the locus \(\Gamma\) of \(P\).
(b) A straight line \(L\) passes through \(A\) with slope \(k\). Find the range of values of \(k\) such that \(L\) intersects \(\Gamma\) at two distinct points.
questions.stemZh:
\(A=(-2,0),B=(1,0)\)，\(P\) 滿足 \(PA=2PB\)。
(a) 求軌跡 \(\Gamma\)。
(b) \(L\) 經過 \(A\)，斜率為 \(k\)。求 \(L\) 與 \(\Gamma\) 交於不同兩點時 \(k\) 的範圍。
questions.hint: Square the ratio. For two intersections, centre-to-line distance < radius.
questions.hintZh: 平方比例。兩交點需中心到線距離 < 半徑。
questions.solution:
(a) \((x+2)^2+y^2=4((x-1)^2+y^2)\) gives \((x-2)^2+y^2=4\).
(b) \(L:kx-y+2k=0\). The distance from centre \((2,0)\) is \(4|k|/\sqrt{k^2+1}\). For two intersections it must be less than \(2\), giving \(k^2<1/3\), or \(-1/\sqrt3<k<1/\sqrt3\).

questions.stem:
Circle \(C_1\) has equation \((x-3)^2+(y-1)^2=25\) with centre \(G\). \(P\) is a moving point such that the length of the tangent drawn from \(P\) to \(C_1\) equals \(\dfrac{PG}{\sqrt{2}}\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) Describe the relationship between \(C_1\) and \(\Gamma\).
(c) Find the equations of the two horizontal tangent lines to \(\Gamma\).
(d) Explain why neither horizontal tangent to \(\Gamma\) intersects \(C_1\).
questions.stemZh:
\(C_1:(x-3)^2+(y-1)^2=25\)，圓心為 \(G\)。從 \(P\) 向圓作切線的長度等於 \(PG/\sqrt2\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\)。
(b) 描述 \(C_1,\Gamma\) 的關係。
(c) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的兩條水平切線。
(d) 解釋為何這兩線均不與 \(C_1\) 相交。
questions.hint: Tangent length² = d² - r². Set equal to d²/2. Then check concentric circles.
questions.hintZh: 切線長² = d² - r²。等於 d²/2。同心圓判斷位置。
questions.solution:
(a) Let \(d=PG\). Tangent length squared is \(d^2-25=d^2/2\), hence \(d^2=50\). Thus \(\Gamma:(x-3)^2+(y-1)^2=50\); \(d>5\), so the tangent exists.
(b) The circles are concentric, with \(C_1\) strictly inside \(\Gamma\).
(c) \(y=1\pm5\sqrt2\).
(d) Both are \(5\sqrt2>5\) from \(G\), greater than the radius of \(C_1\), so neither intersects it.

14. The \(y\)-intercepts of two parallel lines \(L\) and \(\ell\) are \(-1\) and \(-3\) respectively and the \(x\)-intercept of \(L\) is \(3\). \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(L\) is equal to the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(\ell\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a)(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(L\).
(a)(ii) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) The equation of the circle \(C\) is
\[
(x-6)^2+y^2=4.
\]Denote the centre of \(C\) by \(Q\).
(b)(i) Does \(\Gamma\) pass through \(Q\)? Explain your answer.
(b)(ii) If \(L\) cuts \(C\) at \(A\) and \(B\) while \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at \(H\) and \(K\), find the ratio of the area of \(\triangle AQH\) to the area of \(\triangle BQK\).
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 平行直線 \(L,\ell\) 的 \(y\) 截距分別為 \(-1,-3\)，\(L\) 的 \(x\) 截距為 \(3\)。動點 \(P\) 到兩線的垂直距離相等，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a)(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(L\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(b) 圓 \(C:(x-6)^2+y^2=4\) 的圓心為 \(Q\)。
(i) \(\Gamma\) 是否經過 \(Q\)？解釋。
(ii) \(L\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(A,B\)；\(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(H,K\)。求 \([AQH]:[BQK]\)。（9 分）
questions.hint: Locus equidistant from two parallel lines is the middle parallel line.
questions.hintZh: 到兩平行線等距是中間平行線。
questions.solution:
(a)(i) The equal-distance locus is the midline, parallel to L.
(ii) The intercepts give \(L:y=x/3-1\); the parallel line is \(\ell:y=x/3-3\). Therefore
\[\Gamma:y=x/3-2,\quad x-3y-6=0.\]
(b)(i) The centre is \(Q=(6,0)\). It satisfies \(6-3(0)-6=0\), so Gamma passes through Q.
(ii) \(QH=QK=2\), the radius. Since A and B lie on L, which is parallel to Gamma, they have equal perpendicular distances from the bases QH and QK. The triangles have equal base lengths and heights, giving \([AQH]:[BQK]=1:1\).
questions.solutionZh:
(a)(i) \(\Gamma\) 是兩線的中線，與 \(L\) 平行。
(ii) \(L:y=x/3-1\)，故中線為 \(y=x/3-2\)，即 \(x-3y-6=0\)。
(b)(i) \(Q=(6,0)\)，代入中線得 \(0\)，所以經過 \(Q\)。
(ii) \(QH=QK=2\)。\(A,B\) 均在與 \(\Gamma\) 平行的 \(L\) 上，到 \(\Gamma\) 的高度相同。因此兩三角形同底長、同高，面積比為 \(1:1\)。

12. The circle \(C\) passes through the point \(A(6,11)\) and the centre of \(C\) is the point \(G(0,3)\).
(a) Find the equation of \(C\).
(b) \(P\) is a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(AP=GP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(ii) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and the line segment \(AG\).
(iii) If \(\Gamma\) cuts \(C\) at \(Q\) and \(R\), find the perimeter of the quadrilateral \(AQGR\).
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
12. 圓 \(C\) 經過 \(A=(6,11)\)，圓心為 \(G=(0,3)\)。
(a) 求 \(C\) 的方程。
(b) 動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(AP=GP\)，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(ii) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與線段 \(AG\) 的幾何關係。
(iii) 若 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(C\) 相交於 \(Q,R\)，求四邊形 \(AQGR\) 的周界。（7 分）
questions.hint: Circle equation: complete square. Locus equidistant from A,G is perpendicular bisector. All sides equal → perimeter.
questions.hintZh: 配方。等距軌跡是垂直平分線。四邊相等求周界。
questions.solution:
(a) \(GA^2=6^2+8^2=100\), so \(C:x^2+(y-3)^2=100\).
(b)(i) Equating squared distances gives \((x-6)^2+(y-11)^2=x^2+(y-3)^2\), hence \(\Gamma:3x+4y-37=0\).
(ii) Gamma is the perpendicular bisector of AG.
(iii) The radius condition gives \(QG=RG=10\), while the locus gives \(QA=QG\) and \(RA=RG\). All four sides of AQGR are 10, so the perimeter is \(4(10)=40\).

questions.stem:
10. The coordinates of the points \(A\) and \(B\) are \((5,7)\) and \((13,1)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(P\) is equidistant from \(A\) and \(B\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(a) Find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(b) \(\Gamma\) intersects the \(x\)-axis and the \(y\)-axis at \(H\) and \(K\) respectively. Denote the origin by \(O\). Let \(C\) be the circle which passes through \(O\), \(H\) and \(K\). Someone claims that the circumference of \(C\) exceeds \(30\). Is the claim correct? Explain your answer.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
10. \(A=(5,7)\)、\(B=(13,1)\)。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A,B\) 等距，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。
(b) \(\Gamma\) 分別與 \(x\) 軸、\(y\) 軸交於 \(H,K\)，原點為 \(O\)。圓 \(C\) 經過 \(O,H,K\)。有人聲稱 \(C\) 的圓周長大於 \(30\)。聲稱是否正確？解釋。（5 分）
questions.hint: Midpoint of AB, perpendicular bisector. Right angle at O means HK is diameter.
questions.hintZh: AB 中點，垂直平分線。直角在 O 即 HK 直徑。
questions.solution:
(a) The midpoint of AB is \((9,4)\), and the slope of AB is \(-3/4\). The perpendicular bisector is \(y-4=\tfrac43(x-9)\), or \(\Gamma:4x-3y-24=0\).
(b) The intercepts are \(H=(6,0)\), \(K=(0,-8)\). Since \(\angle HOK=90^\circ\), HK is a diameter of the circle through O,H,K. Its length is \(\sqrt{6^2+8^2}=10\). The circumference is \(10\pi\approx31.42>30\), so the claim is correct.

17. (a) Let \(a\) and \(p\) be the area and the perimeter of \(\triangle CDE\) respectively. Denote the radius of the inscribed circle of \(\triangle CDE\) by \(r\). Prove that
\[
pr=2a.
\](b) The coordinates of the points \(H\) and \(K\) are \((9,12)\) and \((14,0)\) respectively. Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(OH\) is equal to the perpendicular distance from \(P\) to \(HK\), where \(O\) is the origin. Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\).
(i) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(\angle OHK\).
(ii) Using (a), find the equation of \(\Gamma\).
(7 marks)
questions.stemZh:
17. (a) 三角形 \(CDE\) 的面積、周界分別為 \(a,p\)，內切圓半徑為 \(r\)。證明 \(pr=2a\)。
(b) \(H=(9,12)\)、\(K=(14,0)\)，\(O\) 為原點。動點 \(P\) 到直線 \(OH,HK\) 的垂直距離相等，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(i) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(\angle OHK\) 的幾何關係。
(ii) 利用 (a) 求 \(\Gamma\) 的方程。（7 分）
questions.hint: Incentre: area = r×s. Unrestricted locus includes both internal and external angle bisectors.
questions.hintZh: 內心：面積 = r×s。無限制要內外角平分線。
questions.solution:
(a) Join the incentre to C,D,E. Each smaller triangle has height r, so \(a=\tfrac12r(CD+DE+EC)=pr/2\). Thus \(pr=2a\).
(b)(i) Without a region restriction, the locus consists of both internal and external angle bisectors of the two intersecting lines.
(ii) \(OH=15,HK=13,OK=14\), the triangle area is 84 and the perimeter is 42. Part (a) gives \(r=168/42=4\). The incentre is \((8,4)\). The internal bisector through H=(9,12) is \(8x-y-60=0\). Its perpendicular through H is the external bisector \(x+8y-105=0\). Retain both branches for the unrestricted statement.
questions.solutionZh:
(a) 連接內心與三頂點，三個小三角形的高皆為 \(r\)，所以 \(a=\tfrac12r(CD+DE+EC)=pr/2\)。
(b)(i) 若動點沒有區域限制，完整軌跡為內、外兩條角平分線。
(ii) \(OH=15\)、\(HK=13\)、\(OK=14\)，面積 \(84\)。由 (a)，\(r=168/42=4\)。內心為 \((8,4)\)，通過內心及 \(H\) 的內角平分線為 \(8x-y-60=0\)。外角平分線與它垂直且通過 \(H\)，為 \(x+8y-105=0\)。因此完整軌跡為這兩條直線；原轉錄答案僅列內角分支。

(a) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(AB\).
(b) Suppose that the coordinates of \(A\) are \((2,-4)\) and the equation of \(\Gamma\) is \(3x+y-12=0\). Find
(i) the equation of the straight line which passes through \(A\) and \(B\),
(ii) the equation of the circle with \(AB\) as a diameter.
(5 marks)
questions.stemZh:
10. \(A,B\) 為直角坐標平面上兩個不同定點。動點 \(P\) 與 \(A,B\) 等距，軌跡記為 \(\Gamma\)。
(a) 描述 \(\Gamma\) 與 \(AB\) 的幾何關係。
(b) 已知 \(A=(2,-4)\)、\(\Gamma:3x+y-12=0\)，求：
(i) 通過 \(A,B\) 的直線方程；
(ii) 以 \(AB\) 為直徑的圓方程。（5 分）
questions.hint: Perpendicular bisector slope = negative reciprocal. Diameter midpoint is circle centre.
questions.hintZh: 垂直平分線斜率是負倒數。直徑中點是圓心。
questions.solution:
(a) Gamma is the perpendicular bisector of AB.
(b)(i) Gamma has slope -3, so AB has slope 1/3. Through A=(2,-4), its equation is \(y+4=(x-2)/3\), or \(x-3y-14=0\).
(ii) Solving this line with \(3x+y-12=0\) gives the diameter midpoint \(G=(5,-3)\). Since \(GA^2=3^2+1^2=10\), the circle is \((x-5)^2+(y+3)^2=10\).

Let \(P\) be a moving point in the rectangular coordinate plane such that \(MP=NP\). Denote the locus of \(P\) by \(\Gamma\). It is given that the equation of \(\Gamma\) is
\[
3x-2y-30=0.
\](a) Describe the geometric relationship between \(\Gamma\) and \(MN\).
(b) Find the equation of \(L\).
(c) Suppose that \(\Gamma\) cuts \(L\) and the \(x\)-axis at the points \(Q\) and \(R\) respectively. Find the area of the quadrilateral \(ONQR\), where \(O\) is the origin.

questions.stemZh:
13. 直線 \(L\) 分別與正 \(x\) 軸、正 \(y\) 軸交於 \(M,N\)。動點 \(P\) 滿足 \(MP=NP\)，軌跡為 \(\Gamma:3x-2y-30=0\)。

(b) 求 \(L\) 的方程。
(c) \(\Gamma\) 分別與 \(L\)、\(x\) 軸交於 \(Q,R\)，\(O\) 為原點。求四邊形 \(ONQR\) 的面積。（7 分）

questions.hintZh: 設 M=(a,0), N=(0,b)。垂直得斜率比。中點代入。
questions.solution:
(a) Gamma is the perpendicular bisector of MN.
(b) Write \(M=(a,0),N=(0,b)\), with a,b positive. The perpendicular slope relation gives \(b/a=2/3\). The midpoint lies on Gamma, so \(3a/2-b=30\). Thus \(a=36,b=24\), and \(L:2x+3y-72=0\).
(c) The x-intercept of Gamma is \(R=(10,0)\). Its intersection with L is \(Q=(18,12)\). Splitting along OQ,
\[[ONQR]=[ONQ]+[OQR]=\tfrac12(24)(18)+\tfrac12(10)(12)=276.\]
